style: Gypsy jazz and avant-garde chamber folk, 1930s Paris club meets post-minimalist structural decay. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Modal Gypsy jazz guitar voicings with quartal extensions and cluster rubs. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast chromatic cabaret patter dissolving into downward yodel register flips and hocketed microtonal slides. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Swinging triplet subdivision invading a frantic Balkan 7/8 pulse with sharp stop-start silences. [TIMBRE SYSTEM] Gypsy jazz acoustic guitar, brushed snare, accordion, upright bass, and vibrating bowed saw. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical manic urgency delivered with deadpan administrative precision. [ANCHOR INVARIANT] A relentless swinging bassline. [OPERATORS] Hold the bass groove fixed while upper strings migrate into microtonal friction; compress the lyric syllable density while stretching the instrumental cadences; make the accordion imitate a failing digital buffer without losing warmth; preserve the pulse while destabilizing harmonies; return to the gypsy swing anchor in a mutated microtonal state.
